name: Sudowrite
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Sudowrite, brainstorm fiction, expand scenes, inspect story context, and generate constrained prose suggestions. The hard boundary is its fiction-tuned workflows, context handling, and model orchestration, plus polish, integrations, and proprietary language models.
